Executive Summary (Layer 4)

Campaign Overview

The pcsk9-oral-live-v2 campaign executed a complete, zero-shortcut, provenance-sealed multi-agent preclinical discovery workflow on Google Cloud (Argolis losiern-oase-workshop) to nominate oase_pcsk9_014, an oral Rule-of-5 azaindole-thiazole small-molecule allosteric inhibitor of PCSK9 (Q8NBP7 / ENSG00000169174). Every computation was executed live inside isolated Scion agent containers (env_version = sha256:2987d3053f138de06c119fb09bd1eed054f75c013cfc25c8b294d1dee2acac5b) and audited by oase validate check.

Read more →

Work OrderRevisionRoleStageDecision Question
WO-001 r1 computational-biologist stage1-intervention-validation Which oral PCSK9 inhibition hypothesis ranks highest across independent Co-Scientist and Hypex Elo tournaments?
WO-002 r1 computational-biologist stage1-intervention-validation Does human genetic constraint (gnomAD v4) and GTEx v8 whole-blood expression de-risk chronic systemic PCSK9 inhibition?
WO-003 r1 computational-biologist stage1-intervention-validation Does live 1P AlphaGenome variant scoring of PCSK9 rs11591147 (chr1:55039974:G>T, R46L) reveal any cis-regulatory or chromatin accessibility liabilities?
WO-004 r1 structural-biologist stage2-starting-matter-declaration Does PCSK9 contain a druggable allosteric pocket (fpocket) and does live 1P AlphaFold 3 co-folding support pcsk9_ic001 complex formation?
WO-005 r1 structural-biologist stage2-starting-matter-declaration Does AutoDock Vina physics-based molecular docking corroborate binding of pcsk9_ic001 inside PCSK9 Pocket #3?
WO-006 r1 medicinal-chemist stage3-candidate-nomination Does BRICS MMP lead optimization (pcsk9_ic001 -> oase_pcsk9_014) resolve lipophilicity while maintaining Rule-of-5 drug-likeness and transparent ADMET relay tracking?
WO-007 r1 admet-dmpk-scientist stage4-human-readiness-package Do Rat and Dog oral PK studies and two-species allometric scaling project a human oral half-life compatible with once-daily dosing for oase_pcsk9_014?
WO-008 r1 science-program-lead stage4-human-readiness-package Is the competitive clinical landscape favorable and is the CTD Module 2.6/4 pre-IND dossier package complete for oase_pcsk9_014?
